title: Just another Trading Bot
author: Best-Hope-5148
selftext:
I built my own crypto trading bot system for Bybit spot and leverage, so I decided to turn it into a shared web app.

The strategies are 100% deterministic — pure quant logic (EMA, RSI, ATR). The AI is only used as an additional layer around the strategy execution, ex:  
A few things it does:  
\- Vetoes trades when negative news is detected for a coin.  
\- Reviews every veto 24 hours later against actual price action and automatically writes a calibration note.  
\- Gets both a “bull” and a “bear” AI perspective before high-impact trades, and only executes when they agree.

If anyone wants to try it or poke at the approach, drop a comment — I’m happy to share access [https://www.tradewbot.com](https://www.tradewbot.com). I’d love to hear your feedback before taking it further.

The first 10 requests are free. 

Enjoy!
